name: Quick Pill 5.5.9
changelog: Fix: Click-through parity in Tauri - area around the pill is now completely non-blocking and pass-through when minimized or idle.
Fix: Prevent extra console/terminal window from opening when launched via Windows subsystem.
Polish: Replaced placeholder icon with crisp high-resolution Quick Pill app, taskbar, and tray icons.
Performance: Zero CPU usage when idle (quiet rendering, smart minute-only clock updates, eliminated background polling churn).
Feature: Event-driven Windows GSMTC media notifications and battery charger change alerts (Menunggu, bukan terus mengecek).
Feature: File shelf now stores up to 100 items by path reference with zero in-memory payload copy.
